originalStory.title: P.S. What's up with the climate?

provenance.copyrightNotice: 'Nimmooralli Bisilu, Male, Chali Hegide?' has been published on StoryWeaver by Pratham Books. www.prathambooks.org.  We're thankful to Radha Rangarajan, photographer, writer and expert on everything non-human, for her inputs on this book. Also thank you to Radhika Suri and the WWF team and Minal Pathak. World Wide Fund For Nature India (WWF-India) endorses Pratham Books’ P. S. What’s up with the climate?, a picture book that raises awareness about complex environmental issues like climate change among young audiences. In today’s time and era, it is critical to nurture appreciation and respect in young children for the environment and its biodiversity. It’s only when they understand, they will act to create a better and brighter future for all.
